package io.github.xyz1001.pdsync.android;

import static pdsync.i18n.AndroidHostMessages.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/** Deterministic host ports. Only the marked production methods and HomeActionContext are real. */
public final class MainActivity {
    enum SyncPage { HOME, CONNECTION, SETTINGS, CONFLICT }
    enum OnboardingProgress { COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE }
    enum OnboardingKind { READY, BLOCKED, BRANCHED }
    enum DiagnosticAction { PUSH, RESOLVE }
    enum SharedHomeStatusKind { CONFLICT, EXPIRED }
    interface Task { Object run() throws Exception; }
    interface SharedBranchChoiceActions {
        void select(String id); void back(); void refresh();
        void overwrite(String id); void merge(); void preserveLocal();
    }
    static final class SecureConnectionStore { static final class Connection {} }
    static final class AndroidSyncFacade {
        static final class Version {
            final String id;
            Version(String id) { this.id = id; }
            String getSnapshotId() { return id; }
        }
        static final class Inspection {
            boolean pending;
            List<Version> branches = List.of(new Version("branch-a"), new Version("branch-b"));
            boolean isRetryablePending() { return pending; }
            List<Version> getRemoteVersions() { return branches; }
        }
        static final class OperationResult {}
        <T>T withUploadReadScope(java.util.concurrent.Callable<T> task)throws Exception{return task.call();}
        int uploads, resolutions;
        Inspection dispatchedObservation;
        String resolvedId;
        OperationResult upload(Inspection observed) {
            uploads++; dispatchedObservation = observed; return new OperationResult();
        }
        OperationResult overwriteCloudSuccessors(Inspection observed, String id) {
            resolutions++; dispatchedObservation = observed; resolvedId = id; return new OperationResult();
        }
    }
    static final class SyncHistory {
        boolean protectedLocal;
        boolean getCurrentProtected() { return protectedLocal; }
    }
    static final class LinearLayout {
        static final class LayoutParams { LayoutParams(int width, int height) {} }
        int removed, added;
        void removeAllViews() { removed++; }
        void setPadding(int a, int b, int c, int d) {}
        void setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(Object listener) {}
        void addView(Object view, LayoutParams layout) { added++; }
    }
    static final class AndroidBranchChoiceComposition {
        // The separate source contract validates every adapter argument and inactive backdrop.
        static Object view(MainActivity activity, Object... args) {
            activity.actions = (SharedBranchChoiceActions) args[args.length - 1];
            activity.adapterObservation = args[0];
            activity.adapterHistory = args[1];
            activity.adapterHomeStatus = (String) args[args.length - 3];
            activity.adapterHomeStatusKind = (SharedHomeStatusKind) args[args.length - 2];
            return new Object();
        }
    }
    static final class SyncRuntime {
        static String currentSelectionToken(MainActivity a) throws Exception {
            if (a.scopeUnavailable) throw new Exception("Synthetic unavailable scope");
            return a.selectionToken;
        }
        static String currentNamespace(MainActivity a) { return a.namespace; }
    }

    SecureConnectionStore.Connection connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection();
    AndroidSyncFacade facade = new AndroidSyncFacade();
    AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection();
    SyncHistory history = new SyncHistory();
    LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout();
    SharedBranchChoiceActions actions;
    Object adapterObservation, adapterHistory;
    String adapterHomeStatus;
    SharedHomeStatusKind adapterHomeStatusKind;
    SyncPage page = SyncPage.CONFLICT;
    OnboardingProgress progress = OnboardingProgress.COMPLETE;
    OnboardingKind observedKind = OnboardingKind.BRANCHED;
    boolean resumed = true, cloudVerified = true, restoreAllowed = true, uploadAllowed = true;
    boolean destroyed, busy, sharedAppreciationOnly, recovery, scopeUnavailable, onboardingActive;
    String selected = "branch-a", selectionToken = "embedded:isolated.game", namespace = "test-only";
    String explicitHomeSelection = "branch-b", notice = "Synthetic conflict";
    int sharedHomeRenderToken, historyPage = 2;
    int navigations, refreshes, renders, operations, merges;
    SyncPage refreshedPage;

    boolean isDestroyed() { return destroyed; }
    boolean restoreSupported() { return restoreAllowed; }
    boolean restoreNeedsAttention() { return recovery; }
    boolean canHomeUpload() { return uploadAllowed; }
    // Full HOME status policy is executed separately by the HOME action harness.
    Object homeContent() { return history; }
    String homeStatus(Object content) { return "Synthetic HOME status"; }
    boolean homeAccountExpired() { return false; }
    SharedHomeStatusKind homeStatusKind(Object content) { return SharedHomeStatusKind.CONFLICT; }
    OnboardingKind kind() { return observedKind; }
    Object selectedGameIdentity() { return "isolated.game"; }
    String visibleNotice() { return notice; }
    AndroidSyncFacade sync() { return facade; }
    void requireRestoreSupport() { if (!restoreAllowed) throw new AssertionError("Unsupported restore reached I/O"); }
    void previewMerge() { merges++; busy = true; }
    void navigate(SyncPage target) { navigations++; page = target; sharedHomeRenderToken++; root = new LinearLayout(); }
    void refreshComparison(SyncPage target) { refreshes++; refreshedPage = target; busy = true; }
    void render() {
        renders++;
        // Production render creates a new legacy root on each CONFLICT render.
        root = new LinearLayout();
        if (page == SyncPage.CONFLICT) renderConflict();
    }
    void operation(DiagnosticAction action, String label, Task task, String success) {
        // Production work publishes busy before scheduling I/O; this port runs synchronously.
        busy = true; operations++;
        try { task.run(); } catch (Exception failure) { throw new AssertionError(failure); }
    }

    static class OperationOutcome {}
    interface Done {void accept(OperationOutcome value)throws Exception;}
    OperationOutcome m54xc977a20(Task task)throws Exception {task.run();return new OperationOutcome();}
    void m55x8211a061(String message,OperationOutcome value) {page=SyncPage.CONFLICT;}
    void work(DiagnosticAction action,String label,Task task,Done done) {
        busy=true;operations++;try {done.accept((OperationOutcome)task.run());}catch(Exception e){throw new AssertionError(e);}
    }
    /* PRODUCTION_METHODS */

    static int checks;
    static void check(boolean value, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
    static MainActivity fresh() {
        MainActivity a = new MainActivity();
        a.renderConflict();
        check(a.root.removed == 1 && a.root.added == 1, "chooser replaces legacy chrome once");
        check(a.adapterObservation == a.inspection && a.adapterHistory == a.history,
                "chooser receives real observation and history");
        check(a.adapterHomeStatus.equals("Synthetic HOME status")
                        && a.adapterHomeStatusKind == SharedHomeStatusKind.CONFLICT,
                "backdrop receives actual home status and status kind");
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0 && a.navigations == 0 && a.merges == 0,
                "drawing chooser has no operation or navigation side effect");
        return a;
    }
    static void invokeAll(SharedBranchChoiceActions actions) {
        actions.overwrite("branch-a"); actions.merge(); actions.preserveLocal();
        actions.select("branch-b"); actions.refresh(); actions.back();
    }
    static void blocked(Consumer<MainActivity> change, String label) {
        MainActivity a = fresh(); SharedBranchChoiceActions old = a.actions;
        change.accept(a);
        int renders = a.renders, navigation = a.navigations;
        String selected = a.selected;
        invokeAll(old);
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.merges == 0 && a.refreshes == 0 && a.navigations == navigation
                        && a.renders == renders && java.util.Objects.equals(selected, a.selected),
                label + ": stale callback dispatched");
    }
    static void resolutionBlocked(Consumer<MainActivity> change, String label) {
        MainActivity a = fresh(); change.accept(a);
        // Render current evidence, so each gate is exercised independently of stale-owner checks.
        a.render(); a.actions.overwrite("branch-a"); a.actions.merge();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.merges == 0, label + ": resolution dispatched");
    }
    static void preserveBlocked(Consumer<MainActivity> change, String label) {
        MainActivity a = fresh(); change.accept(a); a.render(); a.actions.preserveLocal();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.facade.uploads == 0, label + ": preserve dispatched");
    }
    static void guards() {
        blocked(a -> a.root = new LinearLayout(), "replaced root");
        blocked(a -> a.page = SyncPage.HOME, "returned home");
        blocked(a -> a.resumed = false, "paused activity");
        blocked(a -> a.destroyed = true, "destroyed activity");
        blocked(a -> a.busy = true, "busy activity");
        blocked(a -> a.sharedAppreciationOnly = true, "appreciation active");
        blocked(a -> a.inspection = new AndroidSyncFacade.Inspection(), "replaced observation");
        blocked(a -> a.facade = new AndroidSyncFacade(), "replaced facade");
        blocked(a -> a.connection = new SecureConnectionStore.Connection(), "replaced account");
        blocked(a -> a.history = new SyncHistory(), "replaced history");
        blocked(a -> a.selectionToken = "root:other.game", "changed game backend");
        blocked(a -> a.namespace = "other-namespace", "changed namespace");
        blocked(a -> a.scopeUnavailable = true, "unavailable current scope");
        blocked(a -> a.sharedHomeRenderToken++, "newer render token");
        MainActivity unavailable = fresh(); unavailable.scopeUnavailable = true; unavailable.render();
        invokeAll(unavailable.actions);
        check(unavailable.operations == 0 && unavailable.refreshes == 0 && unavailable.navigations == 0,
                "unavailable owner scope: callback dispatched");
    }
    static void selectionAndCancellation() {
        MainActivity a = fresh(); SharedBranchChoiceActions old = a.actions;
        old.select("unknown-branch");
        check(a.renders == 0 && a.selected.equals("branch-a"), "unknown branch cannot be selected");
        old.select("branch-b");
        check(a.renders == 1 && a.selected.equals("branch-b") && a.operations == 0,
                "select only rerenders observed branch");
        invokeAll(old);
        check(a.renders == 1 && a.operations == 0 && a.merges == 0 && a.navigations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0,
                "callback after selection render is stale");
        a.actions.overwrite("branch-a"); a.actions.overwrite("unknown-branch");
        check(a.operations == 0, "overwrite must match selected observed branch");
        SharedBranchChoiceActions selected = a.actions;
        selected.overwrite("branch-b"); selected.overwrite("branch-b"); selected.merge(); selected.preserveLocal();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.facade.resolutions == 1 && a.facade.uploads == 0 && a.merges == 0,
                "busy repeated confirmation is dispatched once");
        check(a.facade.dispatchedObservation == a.inspection && a.facade.resolvedId.equals("branch-b"),
                "resolve keeps exact observation and selected ID");
        a = fresh(); a.selected = "unknown-branch"; a.render(); a.actions.overwrite("unknown-branch");
        check(a.operations == 0, "selected ID must still belong to observed branches");
        blocked(MainActivity::render, "explicit rerender");
        a = fresh(); old = a.actions; old.back(); invokeAll(old);
        check(a.page == SyncPage.HOME && a.navigations == 1 && a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0,
                "cancel returns home once and invalidates retained callbacks");
        a = fresh(); a.onboardingActive = true; a.actions.back();
        check(a.page == SyncPage.CONNECTION && a.navigations == 1 && a.operations == 0,
                "existing onboarding back route is retained");
        a = fresh(); old = a.actions; old.refresh(); old.refresh();
        check(a.refreshes == 1 && a.refreshedPage == SyncPage.HOME && a.operations == 0,
                "refresh uses existing home read and busy guard");
    }
    static void capabilities() {
        resolutionBlocked(a -> a.inspection = null, "missing observation");
        resolutionBlocked(a -> a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.READY, "unbranched observation");
        resolutionBlocked(a -> a.cloudVerified = false, "unverified observation");
        resolutionBlocked(a -> a.connection = null, "disconnected account");

        resolutionBlocked(a -> a.recovery = true, "unfinished restore");
        resolutionBlocked(a -> a.inspection.pending = true, "pending upload");
        MainActivity a = fresh(); a.actions.merge(); a.actions.merge();
        check(a.merges == 0 && a.operations == 0, "removed merge never dispatches");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.inspection = null, "preserve missing observation");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.observedKind = OnboardingKind.READY, "preserve unbranched observation");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.cloudVerified = false, "preserve unverified observation");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.connection = null, "preserve disconnected account");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.recovery = true, "preserve unfinished restore");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.history = null, "preserve missing history");
        preserveBlocked(b -> b.history.protectedLocal = true, "preserve already protected");
        a = fresh(); a.restoreAllowed = false; a.inspection.pending = true; a.render();
        SharedBranchChoiceActions old = a.actions; old.preserveLocal(); old.preserveLocal();
        check(a.facade.uploads == 0 && a.operations == 0 && a.facade.resolutions == 0 && a.merges == 0,
                "removed preserve never dispatches");
        check(a.facade.dispatchedObservation == null, "removed preserve retains no dispatched observation");
    }
    static void ordinaryUploadRouting() {
        MainActivity a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.observedKind = OnboardingKind.READY;
        a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.facade.uploads == 1 && a.navigations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0,
                "ordinary upload stays direct without a chooser or confirmation");
        a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 1 && a.facade.uploads == 1 && a.navigations == 0,
                "existing branched upload dispatch stays unchanged");
        a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.uploadAllowed = false; a.requestUpload(); a.upload();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 0, "ordinary upload preserves its existing source gate");
        a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.inspection = null; a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 1 && a.refreshedPage == SyncPage.HOME,
                "missing upload observation only refreshes home");
        a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.cloudVerified = false; a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.refreshes == 1, "unverified upload observation only refreshes home");
        a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.connection = null; a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.page == SyncPage.CONNECTION, "disconnected upload returns to connection");
        a = fresh(); a.page = SyncPage.HOME; a.progress = OnboardingProgress.INCOMPLETE; a.requestUpload();
        check(a.operations == 0 && a.onboardingActive && a.page == SyncPage.CONNECTION,
                "unfinished configuration keeps existing connection route");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        guards(); selectionAndCancellation(); capabilities(); ordinaryUploadRouting();
        System.out.println("branch choice host execution passed: " + checks + " checks");
    }
}
